content: अरणिः {%m., f.%} -णी {%f.%} ¦ [ऋ-अनि <ls>Uṇ. 2. 101</ls>; अरणिः अग्नेर्योनिः] A piece of wood (of the Śamī tree) used for kindling the sacred fire by attrition, the fire-producing wooden stick; प्रयच्छन्ति फलं भूमिररणीव हुताशनम् <ls>Pt. 1. 216</ls>. .{@-णी@} (dual) The two pieces of wood used in kindling the sacred fire. धरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदाः <ls>Kaṭh. 4. 8</ls>. .{@-णिः@} .²1 The sun. .²2 fire. .²3 Flint. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of several fire-producing plants, particularly अग्निमन्थ, .{@-णिः@} {%f.%} .²1 A path, way. .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> Stinginess. .²3 Discomfort; निररणि सविता साविषक् <ls>Av. 1. 18. 2</ls>.
